UniqueEquipmentTraits.Core.Armor.ArmorTr.label: overdrive
UniqueEquipmentTraits.Core.Armor.ArmorTr.description: An experimental combat augmentation system that pushes the wearer's physical capabilities beyond their natural limits. A network of neural accelerators and synthetic muscle stimulators synchronizes with the nervous system, allowing the body to respond with extraordinary speed and precision. However, the immense physiological strain places a heavy burden on the wearer, leaving their body severely exhausted once the system disengages.
